chapters.title: Vendors: the suppliers we buy from
chapters.text: This is Vendors, the list of suppliers we buy from. It shows what we have billed with each, what we have paid, and what is still outstanding.

chapters.title: Tap + New Vendor
chapters.text: To add a supplier, tap plus New Vendor.

chapters.title: Type their name and phone
chapters.text: Type the supplier's name and their phone number. The company, email and notes are optional.

chapters.title: Tap a vendor to see their bills and payments
chapters.text: Tap any vendor to see their bills and payments, and how much is still outstanding.

chapters.title: 🚩 No contact: vendors to complete
chapters.text: The red flag button lists vendors with no contact number or location, so you can complete them. Tap it again to see everyone.

chapters.title: Or search by name
chapters.text: Or search for a vendor by name. The laws of this page, and this video, are on the Laws button.
